justification: Conducted in 1982 by the Institute for Sociology and Social Policy at the Academy of Sciences of the GDR, this survey dataset examines working conditions, female labor force participation, shift work, family care responsibilities, childcare access, and leisure time among trade workers in the GDR.

A longitudinal study initiated in 1986 by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig that captures empirical data on GDR youth, covering health, leisure behavior, family background, gender role attitudes, and educational/occupational pathways.

Provides administrative data on citizen petitions (Eingaben) submitted in the GDR, capturing public grievances and institutional metrics on working conditions, healthcare, family support, housing, and social conditions during the 1980s.

returned_title: National Integrated Survey of Households (NISH): National Consumer Survey and Labour Force Surveys (1981–1986)
justification: Conducted by Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics (formerly Federal Office of Statistics), this survey series collected microdata across Nigerian states including Lagos during the 1980s on employment, household expenditures, market involvement, trade, and living conditions.

returned_title: World Values Survey / Integrated Values Surveys (1981–2022)
justification: A longitudinal cross-national survey dataset starting with Wave 1 (1981–1984) that measures social attitudes, community life, employment priorities, market/economic perceptions, and civic engagement.

returned_title: Nigeria - Public Delivery of Primary Health Care Services 2002 (World Bank Microdata Library)
justification: A World Bank facility and household survey microdata set focusing on urban Lagos and rural Kogi that evaluates community participation, local governance, and the availability and use of primary social services.

Houses historical and cross-national social, economic, labor, and community research data collections covering West Africa and Nigeria across key themes including trade, employment, urban life, and social services.

returned_title: Dataset of the survey on the digital transformation of business processes at universities in Germany
justification: This Zenodo dataset from a 2022 nationwide survey covers 123 German universities, evaluating digital maturity, IT infrastructure, administrative process digitalization, and digital transformation policies across higher education institutions in Germany.

Conducted in early 2023 by the German Centre for Higher Education Research and Science Studies (DZHW), this dataset provides survey data from academic research personnel in Germany on research conditions, digital scholarly communication, digital infrastructure, and science policy attitudes.

returned_title: Die Studierendenbefragung in Deutschland (2021) [The Student Survey in Germany 2021]
justification: A nationwide dataset collecting responses from over 170,000 university students in Germany in 2021, capturing data on digital learning conditions during the COVID-19 pandemic, social and economic background, and university policy implementation.

returned_title: Digitale Lernangebote zum Thema Künstliche Intelligenz
justification: This dataset provides an overview and mapping of free digital learning offerings and artificial intelligence courses across German higher education learning platforms in 2020, focusing on AI adoption and educational policy in German universities.

This longitudinal dataset tracks early-career university researchers and doctoral candidates across Germany, collecting data on working conditions, research outputs, digitalization of doctoral studies, and academic career policies in the 2020s.
Provides election returns, voter turnout, and demographic indicators across administrative districts in the German Empire for Reichstag elections between 1871 and 1912.

returned_title: Election and Social Data of the Districts and Municipalities of the German Empire from 1920 to 1933
justification: Offers detailed electoral results and socio-economic aggregate data for municipalities and districts across the German Reich during the Weimar Republic period.
Compiles long-term historical time series on demography, economy, trade, public finance, and social indicators covering historical German lands, the German Reich, and post-WWII Germany.

returned_title: The German Local Population Database (GPOP), 1871 to 2019
justification: Contains historical municipal and county population census data for Germany across benchmark years starting in 1871, harmonized to modern spatial boundaries.

returned_title: Chronicling Germany: An Annotated Historical Newspaper Dataset
justification: Provides annotated pages, OCR, and layout segmentation data from historical German-language newspapers published between 1852 and 1924.

returned_title: Kölner Wahlstudie (Dortmund, Arnsberg-Soest, Heilbronn, München; Juli 1961)
justification: Conducted in July 1961 by Erwin K. Scheuch et al. and archived at GESIS, this study surveyed residents in urban (e.g., Dortmund) and rural (e.g., Arnsberg-Soest) administrative districts in North Rhine-Westphalia regarding social structures, community life, and local political views.

This 1961 survey dataset available through GESIS contains population-level data on West German urban and rural life, social values, and community attitudes, with regional coverage including North Rhine-Westphalia.

This historical statistical dataset curated by GESIS integrates official census data (including the 1961 Census) at the state and municipal levels for North Rhine-Westphalia, providing insights into local demographic and community life across urban and rural divisions.

returned_title: Aids im Bewußtsein der Bevölkerung der DDR 1990
justification: This dataset from GESIS contains survey data collected in 1989–1990 by the GDR's Central Institute for Hygiene, Microbiology, and Epidemiology alongside the Institute for Sociology and Social Policy. It specifically measures AIDS awareness, knowledge of specific infectious diseases, and health-related behaviors in the German Democratic Republic.

Initiated in 1987 by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in Leipzig, GDR, this longitudinal study tracks physical and mental health, general well-being, and socio-psychological indicators of young people in East Germany through the late 1980s and 1990s.

Conducted in 1987 by the ZIJ in Leipzig, GDR, this dataset captures health conditions, physical fitness, health-related life goals, and sports/lifestyle habits of youth in the German Democratic Republic during the late 1980s.

Expanded into the GDR in June 1990 prior to official reunification, the Socio-Economic Panel dataset offers representative longitudinal microdata on general health, satisfaction, well-being, and living conditions in East Germany.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: This study, conducted by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ) in East Germany starting in 1968, surveyed youth in the GDR on topics including leisure activities, weekend routines, sports engagement, and cultural participation during the late 1960s.

returned_title: Special Eurobarometer 386: Europeans and Their Languages
justification: Conducted in 2012 across European Union member states (including Belgium, Germany, Spain, Greece, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Finland, Slovenia, Cyprus, Malta, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Sweden, UK, and Lithuania), this survey dataset measures citizens' language skills, language use in daily life and media, multilingualism, and attitudes toward language learning.

A comprehensive directory and dataset of digital media outlets in Spain and Portugal developed through research projects spanning the 2010s and early 2020s, mapping outlet typologies, primary language of operation, ownership structures, and digital media characteristics.

Fielded in 2010 across multiple European countries, this cross-national survey dataset records individual-level information regarding language spoken at home, minority language group identification, and detailed news media usage (television, radio, newspapers, and online media).

Led by the Centre for Media Pluralism and Media Freedom at the European University Institute, this monitoring infrastructure gathered systematic data across EU member states during the 2010s on media ownership concentration, protection of minority/regional languages in media, and public service media neutrality.

This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive contains survey data on Duisburg residents collected in Autumn 2000, covering urban living conditions, employment and vocational training opportunities, local infrastructure, community life, and social attitudes.
This GESIS survey examines housing satisfaction, local economic climate, municipal administration, leisure and sports facilities, public security, and community life in Duisburg in 2001.
This dataset targets non-German residents in Duisburg in 2004, covering integration, employment, family life, community perception, leisure, and socio-psychological attitudes.
This dataset surveys Duisburg citizens in 2005, collecting data on living standards, municipal policies, safety and crime perceptions, leisure activities, family structures, and employment.

This dataset collects survey responses from immigrant and ethnic minority residents in Duisburg in 2006, measuring employment, vocational training, social behavior, family life, and community involvement.

This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive contains survey data collected in 1972 by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) in the German Democratic Republic (GDR). It addresses East German youth, student attitudes towards political systems, government, education, and career/employment expectations during the 1970s.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: This GESIS Data Archive dataset (ZA6151) documents a 1970 survey wave conducted in the German Democratic Republic by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ). It covers youth development, family life, marriage/partnerships, cultural activities, political attitudes, and social relations in 1970s East Germany.

This dataset from the GESIS Data Archive (ZA6144) holds empirical survey data from 1973 in the German Democratic Republic conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ). It investigates young workers, employment conditions, family life and marriage, media, and health/reproductive topics in the GDR during the 1970s.
Provides official registration data on protest movements, topics, dates, and participant numbers across major German cities (including Berlin) during the 2020s.

returned_title: ACLED Germany Conflict and Demonstration Event Data
justification: Tracks disaggregated protest, demonstration, and civil unrest events across Germany (including Berlin and nationwide farmers' protests) continuously from 2020 onwards.
Includes country-level modeling data for Germany evaluating agricultural policy pathways, food system security, land-use change, and agricultural emissions.

returned_title: RKI Open Data - Gesundheitsberichterstattung: Daten zu nichtübertragbaren Erkrankungen
justification: Maintained by the Robert Koch Institute, this dataset provides key indicators on public health, dietary behaviors, and nutrition policy/prevention outcomes in Germany for the 2020s.
